subject: Partner-led discovery: Next steps and demo scheduling (CloudBridge)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@cloudbridge.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partner-led discovery: Next steps and demo scheduling (CloudBridge)

Hi Alex / Samir,

Thanks again for the intro call earlier - really appreciate CloudBridge taking the time. Quick recap from our side:

- Primary use case: marketplace listing + single-sign-on flow for marketplace customers, with predictable inference latency and clear billing handoff.
- Current constraints: customer data must remain in their VPC for compliance; procurement timeline targets end of Q2.
- Key stakeholders: Alex (partnership lead), Samir (solutions engineer), Mateo (Redwood partner PM).

Next steps we recommended on the call: schedule a partner-led demo + technical deep-dive where our infra/solutions engineer can walk through the integration points (SSO, billing, telemetry). Can we align on a 60-75 minute slot next week? Below are windows that work for our engineer (Mateo) and myself:

- Tue 17 Mar: 10:00-11:30 PT
- Wed 18 Mar: 13:00-15:00 PT
- Thu 19 Mar: 09:00-11:00 PT

If none of those work, send over 2-3 slots that suit your team and we’ll pick one. Draft agenda: 1) 15m partner context & goals, 2) 30-40m technical deep dive (SSO, marketplace integration, billing mapping), 3) 10-15m next steps & mutual action plan.

I’ve attached a one-page integration map we’ll walk through in the demo. Also flag any security/compliance checklist items Samir wants us to prep ahead of time (SOC 2 evidence pointers, network/IP allowlists).

Thanks - looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Partner Growth Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: RDW_CloudBridge_Integration_Map.pdf (1 page)

Marissa - thanks for the clear recap and the map, this is helpful.

We’re excited to move forward. Samir and I are available and can make the following windows:

- Wed 18 Mar: 13:30-14:30 PT (works for our EU customers team)
- Thu 19 Mar: 09:30-10:30 PT

Prefer Wed 18 at 13:30 if that works for you and Mateo. Samir - I’ve looped you as the SE lead; can you confirm if you want any pre-reads from Redwood (network diagrams, certs) before the call?

I’ll hold Wed 18 13:30-14:30 PT tentatively and confirm after Samir replies.

Thanks,

Perfect - Wed 18 Mar 13:30 PT works for us.

Proposed agenda (60-75m):
1) 10m introductions & goals (Alex)
2) 35-40m tech deep-dive (Samir + Redwood infra) - SSO, marketplace listing flow, billing mapping, required network rules
3) 10m security/compliance checkpoints (SOC 2 evidence, audit logs, data residency)
4) 10m next steps & mutual action plan (who owns what, timelines)

Mateo will cover the infra path and demo the marketplace listing flow. Samir - if you can share any pre-reads, we’ll circulate ahead of time. I’ve added Camila (partnership ops) to help capture the mutual action plan and follow up on procurement items.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=czEyM2Fic2hAZ21haWwuY29t (Wed, 18 Mar 2026 13:30 PT)
Drive folder with prep: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFgHiJkLmNoPqR (includes the integration map and a short checklist)

Attachment: CloudBridge_Marketplace_Primer.pptx (10 slides)

See you then - I’ll send an invite to lock the slot and include dial-in details.

Best,

Marissa
